collections.name: YouTube Channels
collections.blurb: The channels worth subscribing to, tagged by software and by what you actually get: tutorials, rigs, breakdowns, scripts.

collections.name: Courses
collections.blurb: Paid and subscription courses, filterable by level, skill, school and price: so you can tell a €20 class from a €1,000 bootcamp before you click.

collections.name: Schools & Teachers
collections.blurb: Where the courses come from, sorted by what they cost and how they teach.

collections.name: Books
collections.blurb: Animation principles, design theory and the few books about storytelling that change how you time a cut.

collections.name: Studios
collections.blurb: Nearly four hundred studios with their sites and cities: for reference, for job hunting, and for seeing who works near you.

collections.name: Galleries & Archives
collections.blurb: The places that already collect the work. Start here instead of scrolling a feed.

collections.name: Awards & Festivals
collections.blurb: Where to submit and where to go, split by what it costs to enter.

collections.name: Tools & Plugins
collections.blurb: Software, plugins, sound, assets and the small utilities: grouped by the job they do rather than by vendor.

collections.name: Free Files
collections.blurb: Rigs, scripts, project files and presets that working motion designers give away.

collections.name: Communities & Podcasts
collections.blurb: Forums, podcasts and newsletters: including the ones about rates and contracts rather than keyframes.

collections.name: Glossary
collections.blurb: The vocabulary, in plain sentences. Principles, craft, process and the technical terms that show up in delivery specs.

collections.name: Timeline
collections.blurb: How motion design got here, from Fantasmagorie to real-time: because the field did not start with After Effects.
